messages:
Eli (Auditor): Hi team — for the upcoming SOC2 spot check we need an evidence bundle that also demonstrates role inheritance and temporary session usage. Specifically: RBAC pre/post snapshots, a role-inheritance matrix for composite roles, STS AssumeRole / session_token access logs, KMS rotation + access-event mappings, vuln triage linked to 'security-impact=prod' tags, and a signed bundle with verification steps. Please map artifacts to control IDs. See ask: https://files.redwood.example.com/audits/spot-inheritance-2026

Marcos (sec-eng): Thanks Eli. Quick clarifying Qs: 1) For role inheritance do you want the evaluated effective principals per role (i.e., flattened membership) or just the diff of the role graph? 2) STS logs — do you want all AssumeRole events or only those that resulted in API calls to sensitive KMS/EC2 actions?

Eli (Auditor): We want flattened effective principals for sampled composite/high-priv roles (so we can validate separation-of-duty). For STS logs, include AssumeRole events plus the subsequent API calls in the same session for sensitive ops (e.g., kms:Decrypt, ec2:TerminateInstances). Retention: 1 year preferred. Manifest must include per-file meta (control_ids + short envelope) and be GPG-signed; timestamps RFC3339 UTC.

Rina (eng-security): Plan: we'll produce:
- RBAC_SNAPSHOTS/sample-<id>-pre.csv and sample-<id>-post.csv (role,principal,type,event_id)
- ROLE_INHERITANCE/role_effective_<id>.csv (role,flattened_principals,source_edges)
- STS/sessions.csv (session_id,principal,assume_ts,expiry_ts,linked_api_events[])
- KMS/rotations.csv (key_alias,key_id,rotation_ts,policy_sha256,cloudtrail_event_id)
- VULN/prod_triage.csv (vuln_id,tag,discover_ts,triage_owner,fix_pr,deploy_ts,incident_id)
- SA/deprov.csv (sa,actor,ts,pr_link,pipeline_run_url)
- control_map.csv (file,control_ids)
- README with verification commands and canonicalization notes
We will flatten role graphs using our internal evaluator and include both the role graph export and the flattened table for auditors to inspect. All timestamps normalized to UTC.

Jules (infra): I'll kick the export and attach oncall trace. @export-bot start job --bundle=inheritance-sts-kms --include=rbac,role_inheritance,sts,kms,vuln,sa

export-bot: Job queued: job_id=job-3076543211-7, started_at=2026-10-03T13:04:21Z, target=s3://redwood-audit-exports/spot-inheritance-2026/job-7. Progress updates will follow here. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Marcos (sec-eng): A few implementation notes: 
- Role flattening: we will document the evaluator algorithm and include the input graph (edges) plus the evaluated output. We'll capture pre/post graphs within 5 minutes of the change event when available.
- STS linkage: sessions.csv will include the AssumeRole event_id and a small array field listing the first 10 linked API event_ids for that session (we'll keep it small). We'll include a mapping file so auditors can replay those event ids in CloudTrail.

Eli (Auditor): Good. Please include the exact jq canonicalization command you use for KMS policy hashing and include both the raw and canonical policy files next to the rotations.csv rows. Also for role_effective files include the commit SHA of any infra-as-code PR that caused role graph changes.

Rina (eng-security): Affirmative — we'll include policy.json + policy_canonical.json and the sha256. role_effective files will have a column commit_sha and pr_link when applicable. We'll also include a short script verify_bundle.sh in the bundle that runs gpg verify and sha256 checks and shows how to map session -> events.

export-bot: job_id=job-3076543211-7 update: gather phase complete. Bundling artifacts into inheritance-sts-kms-job-7.tar.gz. Generating manifest and signing with audit GPG key.

Jules (infra): Uploaded. Presigned URL (7d): https://s3-presigned.redwood.example.com/spot-inheritance-2026/job-7/inheritance-sts-kms-job-7.tar.gz?X-Amz-Expires=604800. Manifest files: inheritance-sts-kms.manifest.sha256 and inheritance-sts-kms.manifest.sig. PM'ing creds.

Eli (Auditor): Downloaded and ran quick checks. One small follow-up: in sessions.csv I found an AssumeRole that linked to an API event where the event_id in the CloudTrail console uses a slightly different casing — can you include event_id normalized to lowercase in both sessions.csv and the manifest so string matches are consistent?

Marcos (sec-eng): Good catch — we'll normalize event IDs to lowercase in a small re-export and update the manifest. We'll also add a note in README about matching event ids in the console (case-insensitive lookup).

export-bot: Queued re-export job_id=job-3076543211-7b for normalization fix. Started at 2026-10-03T16:20:00Z. Uploading updated bundle soon.

Eli (Auditor): Thanks — will re-check once new link posted. Appreciate the thoroughness. :thumbsup:
